verdict.rationale: Raygun's evidence points to its own client SDKs: open-source .NET providers praised by a long-time user, WinRT support, a changelog entry for an SDK-level SendInBackground queueing feature in .NET Core, and client-side filtering of sensitive data before errors are sent. Nothing in the pack documents an official SDK catalog, language coverage, or SDK reference docs, so the depth of this support is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party SDK documentation listing supported languages, SDK API reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
